notes: compress::lzw: Reader/Writer with Go's Close, Reset and latched errors over LSB/MSB widths 2..8; new_reader has no output budget (Reader::new takes an opt-in bound); constructors and Reset are infallible and report a bad litWidth on the first Read/Write/Close, as Go does, checked by tools/lzw_check.py; TIFF variant unsupported

NewReader.note: infallible and unbounded as in Go; Reader::with_max_output sets an opt-in output bound; a bad litWidth is reported by the first Read

NewWriter.note: infallible as in Go: an invalid litWidth is reported by the first Write or Close

Reader.Reset.note: infallible as in Go: an invalid litWidth is reported by the first Read

Writer.Reset.note: infallible as in Go: an invalid litWidth is reported by the first Write or Close
